_README: Ground truth about every crystal structure this project builds from, stated PER CHAIN.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The facts below were known and written down in several places,
and a system still got built on the opposite assumption for 3 x 300 ns. What went
wrong was not that the information was missing: it was that the system was NAMED
'S3_apo_dimer', and the name acted as a summary that outranked the records saying
3K3K chain B is closed and holo. A name that encodes a claim will eventually be
So the facts live here, in a file the BUILD SCRIPTS READ AND ASSERT AGAINST
(lib_resnumber.assert_provenance). Prose can be misremembered; an assertion that
runs before tleap cannot. If a value here disagrees with the structure, the build
stops -- and if reality turns out to differ from this file, fix the file with a
measurement, never by loosening the check.
Every number below was measured, not quoted: ligand contacts at 4.5 A heavy-atom,
conformational state by superposing each chain's core (152 residues, gate and latch
excluded) onto 3QN1 chain A and taking backbone RMSD over gate 85-89.

3K3K.description: PYR1 homodimer -- MIXED, not apo. Do not describe this structure as apo.

A.note: Genuinely apo AND open. This is the correct source for S1_apo_open.

B.note: CLOSED and ABA-BOUND. Any system built from this chain must keep its ABA, and that ABA's coordinates must come from 3K3K -- data/md/A8S.mol2 carries the 3QN1 pose and is in the wrong frame.

A.note: Residue 2 is ALA, not the wild-type PRO. This is a MUTATION, not a gap, and it propagated into AF3, BindCraft and Boltz. Restored to PRO by script 67.

B.note: A 175-511 construct of a 511-residue protein, so no build yields 'the whole protein' -- cap the construct boundary rather than extending it. All three gaps sit 32-50 A from PYR1, the gate, ABA and the Mn site.
